content:
I've been looking over the network bindings for sockets, such as linux/net.h and linux/socket.h to start with, and can't see that any of the safe abstractions have been started. I very much would like to be able to create some new protocol families. My search for on-going work in this area is to no avail.

Is the idea that, once we have something minimally working, we can submit to a past subtree branch that apparently needs reviving such as staging/rust-net for initial feedback? And if all is resolved, continue on from there? Pushing early and often?

Looking for any advice on how to properly get started and getting the process correct since this is a serious time commitment.

Thanks,
